sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT ?genesisModelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?comp) AS ?sharedComponents) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?compName; separator=" | ") AS ?components)
WHERE {
  ?kMake rc:name "KIA" .
  ?kModel rc:ofMake ?kMake ; rc:name "TELLURIDE" .
  ?kVar rc:ofModel ?kModel .
  ?kRecall rc:affects ?kVar ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .

  ?gMake rc:name "GENESIS" .
  ?gModel rc:ofMake ?gMake ; rc:name ?genesisModelName .
  ?gVar rc:ofModel ?gModel .
  ?gRecall rc:affects ?gVar ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .

  ?comp rc:name ?compName .
}
GROUP BY ?genesisModelName
ORDER BY DESC(?sharedComponents) ?genesisModelName
